# `FluxHostApi::plugin_root`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-ABI">ABI</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **ABI v4** (`src/plugins/abi.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Returns the absolute plugin package root visible to the runtime plugin.

## Signature

```rust
fn plugin_root (& self) -> Result < String , FluxStatus >
```

## Arguments

This method does not take plugin-supplied arguments.

## Return Value

Result < String , [`FluxStatus`](../structures/fluxstatus.md) >

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/fluxhostapi-plugin-root.md`](../../examples/methods/fluxhostapi-plugin-root.md)_

```rust
fn print_plugin_root(host: &FluxHostApi) -> FluxStatus {
    let plugin_root = match host.plugin_root() {
        Ok(path) => path,
        Err(status) => return status,
    };
    println!("plugin root: {plugin_root}");
    FluxStatus::OK
}
```
